# Published reading edition / 公开阅读版

The complete Chinese and English book through Chapter 31 is online:
https://chance-mathematics-six-chapters.goldenmath7.chatgpt.site/

Complete offline website and all editable sources:
https://chance-mathematics-six-chapters.goldenmath7.chatgpt.site/downloads/complete-offline.zip
